title: Final build (machined adapters, metal links)
about: The limits the RS-04 configuration tool and its bridge enforce on the final build's legs. The cap is the firmware's until the per-build caps of issue #202 land; then this profile consumes theirs. A number with a 'sources' entry is checked against its source by rig/tests/test_rs04_vectors.py.

limits.limit_torque_nm.name: GP_RS04_LIMIT_TORQUE
limits.limit_torque_nm.what: D38's cap, written into every motor at boot; issue #202 replaces it with a per-build cap

limits.can_timeout_ticks.name: GP_RS04_CAN_TIMEOUT
limits.can_timeout_ticks.what: 0.1 s without a frame and the motor drops to reset

limits.can_timeout_max_ticks.name: GP_RS04_CAN_TIMEOUT
limits.can_timeout_max_ticks.what: the tool never sets a longer watchdog than the firmware's

motor_config.limit_torque.name: GP_RS04_LIMIT_TORQUE
motor_config.limit_torque.what: the cap stored in the motor

jog_basis: The jog limits are the tool's own, for a configuration jog on the robot with its legs in the air: 5 N m and 2 rad/s, Kp 40 N m/rad reaches the jog torque at 0.125 rad.
notes: The firmware writes its own limit_torque and canTimeout into every motor at boot (gp_rs04.c), whatever the motor has stored.
Not for the PLA leg: its parts are rated for the pla-bench cap only.

references.what: the balance firmware: motor ids, buses and boot configuration
the over-command audit and the per-build caps
